name: B10-0354/2026 (PfE) – Ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns an attack on Kawel village in Nigeria on 21–22 June 2026, where 23 people were killed, including a pastor and an army officer. It says Christians in Plateau State and Nigeria's Middle Belt are being deliberately targeted because of their religion, and that this has signs of genocide. It asks Nigeria to protect these communities, investigate the attack and prosecute those responsible, and asks the European Union to raise the issue with Nigeria.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet in law. Parliament states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Nigeria's government, security forces, Christian communities, and European Union diplomats.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to Nigerian, United States, African Union, ECOWAS and United Nations authorities.
